mapper.sql: id, product_detail_id, seckill_price, total_stock, remain_stock, start_time, end_time, status, merchant_id, gmt_created, gmt_modified

sa.id, sa.product_detail_id, sa.seckill_price, sa.total_stock, sa.remain_stock, sa.start_time, sa.end_time, sa.status, sa.merchant_id, sa.gmt_created, sa.gmt_modified, pd.price as original_price, p.name as product_name, p.product_imgs as product_img
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `seckill_activity` (id, product_detail_id, seckill_price, total_stock, remain_stock, start_time, end_time, status, merchant_id, gmt_created, gmt_modified) VALUES (#{id}, #{productDetailId}, #{seckillPrice}, #{totalStock}, #{remainStock}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{status}, #{merchantId}, #{gmtCreated}, #{gmtModified})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM `seckill_activity` sa LEFT JOIN `product_detail` pd ON pd.id = sa.product_detail_id LEFT JOIN `product` p ON p.id = pd.product_id WHERE sa.status = 'ONGOING' AND sa.start_time <= NOW() AND sa.end_time >= NOW() ORDER BY sa.start_time ASC

SELECT FROM `seckill_activity` sa LEFT JOIN `product_detail` pd ON pd.id = sa.product_detail_id LEFT JOIN `product` p ON p.id = pd.product_id WHERE sa.merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND sa.status = 'ONGOING' AND sa.start_time <= NOW() AND sa.end_time >= NOW() ORDER BY sa.start_time ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE `seckill_activity` SET product_detail_id = #{productDetailId}, seckill_price = #{seckillPrice}, total_stock = #{totalStock}, remain_stock = #{remainStock}, start_time = #{startTime}, end_time = #{endTime}, gmt_modified = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
